Feature: Admin and Patient Management

  As an admin, I should be able to edit labs and pharmacy details
  As a patient, I should be able to register, update my profile, make appointments, and generate prescription reports
  As a doctor, I should be able to provide consultations, prescribe medicine, and lab tests

Scenario Outline: Admin and Patient Management
  Given I am an <role>
  When I <action>
  Then I should be able to <outcome>

Examples:
  | role   | action                 | outcome                                                      |
  | Admin  | edit labs details       | labs details are updated in the system                          |
  | Patient | register               | patient is registered in the system                            |
  | Patient | update profile         | patient's profile is updated in the system                      |
  | Patient | make appointments      | appointment is scheduled in the system                         |
  | Patient | generate prescription | prescription report is generated in the system                 |
  | Doctor  | provide consultation   | consultation is provided to the patient                         |
  | Doctor  | prescribe medicine     | medicine is prescribed to the patient                           |
  | Doctor  | prescribe lab tests    | lab tests are prescribed to the patient                           |

Scenario Outline: Error and Boundary Cases
  Given I am an <role>
  When I <action> with <invalid_value>
  Then I should receive <error_message>

Examples:
  | role   | action                 | invalid_value                 | error_message                                                      |
  | Admin  | edit labs details       | invalid lab name                | "Lab name is invalid"                                             |
  | Patient | register               | duplicate patient ID             | "Patient ID already exists"                                        |
  | Patient | update profile         | invalid profile data             | "Profile data is invalid"                                           |
  | Patient | make appointments      | past appointment date             | "Appointment date cannot be in the past"                             |
  | Patient | generate prescription | invalid prescription format      | "Prescription format is invalid"                                     |
  | Doctor  | provide consultation   | invalid consultation request    | "Consultation request is invalid"                                    |
  | Doctor  | prescribe medicine     | invalid medicine name            | "Medicine name is invalid"                                           |
  | Doctor  | prescribe lab tests    | invalid lab test name            | "Lab test name is invalid"                                           |

Scenario Outline: Doctor and Patient Management
  Given I am a <role>
  When I <action>
  Then I should be able to <outcome>

Examples:
  | role   | action                 | outcome                                                      |
  | Doctor  | provide consultation   | consultation is provided to the patient                         |
  | Doctor  | prescribe medicine     | medicine is prescribed to the patient                           |
  | Doctor  | prescribe lab tests    | lab tests are prescribed to the patient                           |
  | Patient | make appointments      | appointment is scheduled in the system                         |
  | Patient | generate prescription | prescription report is generated in the system                 |
  | Patient | update profile         | patient's profile is updated in the system                      |
  | Patient | register               | patient is registered in the system                            |
